criteria_source: The fixture only. DR-PLAN.md commits to losing at most 15 minutes of orders in a regional outage, while its proposal copies only the nightly snapshot out of us-east-1 and its current-state section says the transaction logs that point-in-time recovery replays stay in us-east-1. The document's own sections contradict each other; the conflict is in the fixture, not in rules/laconic.md.
trap: Passes when the answer names the conflict between the 15-minute commitment and what survives losing us-east-1 - the only copy outside the region is the nightly snapshot, and point-in-time recovery's transaction logs stay in us-east-1, so a regional outage can lose up to about a day of orders - and resolves it, with something that moves changes out of the region continuously (a cross-region replica, cross-region replication of the automated backups and their transaction logs, or shipping WAL to us-west-2), or by renegotiating the commitment. Fails when it calls the plan sound, or raises only the four-hour recovery target, the drill cadence, snapshot retention, encryption keys, the DNS TTL, Multi-AZ or cost while leaving the 15-minute conflict unchallenged.
